t: A tiny Linux computer with real-time helpers and a battery charger.
steps: Buy the board from DigiKey, Mouser or Crowd Supply.
Get a good microSD card and a USB-C data cable.
Download the latest Debian image for PocketBeagle 2 from the Beagle docs.
Write the image to the card with an image writing app.
Insert the card and plug the board into your computer over USB-C.
Follow the quick start guide in the Beagle docs to log in.
Blink an LED on a header pin with a short Python example.
meta: Open Board. From $29.29. A few stores.
